Authentication._comment: Same IdP configuration as nexus-platform (ADR-0006): Keycloak locally, Entra ID in Azure. RequireHttpsMetadata is not set here; it defaults to true/false based on whether Authority itself starts with https://.

RequestLimits._comment: 10 MB default body limit lives under Kestrel:Limits:MaxRequestBodySize above. These two keys raise it to 500 MB only for the (not-yet-implemented) documents upload endpoint.

RateLimiting._comment: Fixed window, partitioned per authenticated user (claim 'oid'), falling back to the client IP for anonymous requests.
